items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-09-01
items.q: I saw Danny Barker on the street a couple of weeks ago. I hadn't seen him in a long time.

ctx.x: Yeah, but, well I mean, the story's about Dizzy Gillespie, ended up stabbing Cab Calloway. Ended up what? Stabbing Cab Calloway. Danny Barker was in the band. Yeah, and he was about, you know, a half an inch or something. No damage or anything. But that's a famous story.
I saw Danny Barker on the street a couple of weeks ago. I hadn't seen him in a long time. Now he's a hell of a storyteller.

Yeah, yeah. Well, anyway, we're getting away from Tony. Did he have dancers then? We talked about him. I can remember. We talked about Lizzy. And of course, Frank would get out and do his act. I don't remember any dances at that time.
